Bartholomew

You are Madam. Bartholomew is your butler.
He does EXACTLY what you say!

  1. 1Read your order. Bartholomew does exactly that… and it goes wrong!
  2. 2Say the order again, with the right word. Then touch the word.
  3. 3In the room, look at the shining thing. Where do you want it?
  4. 4Say your sentence first: “Please put …” Then build it and ring the bell.
Bartholomew is getting ready...

Clock
Subtitles
Four of Bartholomew's six mistakes, then five wishes in the room (in, on, under, next to). Everything is drawn at random. A wrong word is never a dead end: Bartholomew does exactly what was said, and only that word opens again.
